title: Marlowe Rewards Share of the Return Shipping Fee
content:
Marlowe Rewards members pay a reduced share of the Returns & Exchanges return shipping fee, or none. The member share follows the returning customer's Marlowe Rewards membership in status active.

| Returning customer's Marlowe Rewards membership | Share of the return shipping fee paid |
|---|---|
| In status active, its tier carries the free return label perk, and it has held that tier since on or before the return's authorization date | Nothing |
| Marlowe Rewards Silver in status active, enrolled at least 60 calendar months before today | 0.75 of it (75 percent) |
| Anyone else | In full |

The rows are read in order. The share multiplies the return shipping fee before the fee is rounded to the cent; a share of nothing makes the fee zero.

## Boundaries

| Fact | Share |
|---|---|
| Free-label tier started on the authorization date | Nothing |
| Free-label tier started the day after the authorization date | Not the first row |
| Silver, active, enrolled exactly 60 calendar months ago | 0.75 |
| Silver, active, enrolled 59 calendar months ago | In full |

Example (hypothetical): a mail label fee of 6.95 for a long-standing Silver member becomes 5.2125 before rounding.
